KEY_ESTABLISHMENT.rationale: ML-KEM provides PQC key encapsulation. Hybrid provides both classical and PQC security during transition. NOTE: ML-KEM is NOT ML-DSA.

SIGNATURE.rationale: ML-DSA provides lattice-based signatures. Hybrid KEX does NOT replace ML-DSA for signatures.

SYMMETRIC_ENCRYPTION.rationale: Grover halving: AES-256 retains ~128-bit post-quantum security.

hybrid_semantics.name: X25519MLKEM768
hybrid_semantics.note: Hybrid KEX. Does NOT provide PQC signature capability. Does NOT imply ML-DSA.

hybrid_semantics.name: SecP256r1MLKEM768
hybrid_semantics.note: Hybrid KEX. Same signature caveat as X25519MLKEM768.

hybrid_semantics.name: SecP384r1MLKEM1024
hybrid_semantics.note: Hybrid KEX with higher security level.
